subject: Joint promo voucher escrow & routing — MarketReach partnership
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@marketreach.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@marketreach.io
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Joint promo voucher escrow & routing — MarketReach partnership

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the call this morning. MarketReach is excited to co-run a joint pilot promotion with Redwood where we provide a pool of partner-funded vouchers that our accelerator cohort can redeem for Redwood Dedicated credits. A few operational asks from our side: 

- We need a mechanism to escrow the vouchers so MarketReach can validate redemption against cohort eligibility before Redwood consumes credits.
- Prefer a time-limited voucher code or an activation endpoint we can call to toggle vouchers live.
- We also need a usage report (per-voucher redemptions, timestamps) weekly for audit.

I've attached a short playbook and the draft T&Cs for your ops and legal review. Would Redwood be willing to (a) accept an escrowed voucher pool managed jointly, and (b) honor a 60-day activation window after issuance?

Attachments: MarketReach_Promo_T&Cs.pdf (82KB), voucher-activation-instructions.md (4KB)

Looking forward to your thoughts — we have a cohort kickoff on Nov 22, so timing is tight.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships | MarketReach
elena@marketreach.io

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@marketreach.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 12:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Joint promo voucher escrow & routing — MarketReach partnership

Elena — thanks, this is clear and helpful.

On the high level: Redwood can support partner-funded voucher pools, but we have two practical constraints we need to confirm before committing to a workflow:

1) Escrow model: we prefer an authorization callback (MarketReach pings our activation API with voucher id + cohort id) that puts the voucher into an active state. That avoids pre-allocating credits. Is MarketReach able to operate that callback?

2) Audit/usage reporting: we can provide a weekly CSV export with redemption rows (voucher_id, customer_email, redeemed_at, tokens_consumed). Our Finance team will need the same export for reconciliation.

Operational asks for Redwood's side: 
- We will route the voucher redemptions through a separate billing bucket (partner-vouchers) so they don't touch the customer's own billing during the pilot.
- We need Legal to review the T&Cs; looping Grace and Aditya for ops & legal/finance alignment.

Suggested next steps: Grace, can you confirm if Legal is okay with a 60-day activation window and joint-escrow callback? Aditya — if this looks good, can you estimate how quickly we can create the partner-vouchers billing bucket and the weekly export?

Thanks — we want to move fast to meet Nov 22.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships (EU) | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Elena Rossi <elena@marketreach.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: MarketReach Ops <ops@marketreach.io>, partners@marketreach.io
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 08:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Joint promo voucher escrow & routing — MarketReach partnership

Hi Kimberly / Team,

Thanks — yes, MarketReach can run the activation callback. Our ops team prefers the callback model since it lets us validate cohort membership server-side before flipping vouchers live. We are happy with (and prefer) a 60-day activation window.

Two clarifications from our side: 
- Can Redwood set a limit on per-voucher max tokens consumed? Some cohort members run expensive eval jobs and we want to avoid accidental overruns.
- For the weekly export, can Redwood include a cumulative remaining-credits field per voucher id so we can see at-a-glance remaining balance?

I've attached a slightly updated T&Cs doc with language about throttles and limits (see clause 3.2). Also included a proposed webhook schema in voucher-activation-instructions.md.

(attachment: MarketReach_Promo_T&Cs.pdf)

If you can confirm the max-per-voucher guard rails, we'll proceed on our side to issue the voucher batch and send you the initial activation webhook credentials.

Best regards,
Elena

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@marketreach.io>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Joint promo voucher escrow & routing — MarketReach partnership

Kimberly / Aditya / Elena — quick update from Legal & Finance after reviewing the T&Cs and playbook: 

- Legal is OK with a 60-day activation window provided clause 5.1 (liability cap) is tightened slightly; Elena, thank you for the editable doc — we'll mark the suggested language and send a tracked-change version by EOD tomorrow.
- Finance is fine with a separate partner-vouchers billing bucket. Aditya, please create the bucket and a per-voucher remaining balance field in the export. Suggested max-per-voucher default: 200,000 tokens. If MarketReach needs a different ceiling per cohort we can accept a per-voucher-override field in the activation webhook.

Action items: 
- Aditya: create partner-vouchers billing bucket and wire up weekly export with remaining_balance column; ETA 72 hours.
- Elena / MarketReach: issue the voucher batch and send activation webhook credentials to ops@redwood.com once Legal's edits are in.
- Kimberly: I'll coordinate the tracked-change T&Cs and confirm the final liability language.

Thanks — looks like we can meet the Nov 22 kickoff if Ops exchanges credentials this week.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
